content_blocks.label: lead_paragraph
content_blocks.text: Environmental advocates are growing increasingly frustrated as some politicians continue to deny the reality of climate change and its dire consequences.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_1
content_blocks.text: The refusal to acknowledge the scientific consensus on climate change has led to a significant slowdown in implementing effective policies to mitigate its impacts.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_2
content_blocks.text: Activists and scientists alike are calling for a more robust response from elected officials, arguing that the time for debate is over and action is imperative.

content_blocks.label: body_paragraph_3
content_blocks.text: In an interview with The Progressive Voice, environmental activist Maria Rodriguez said, 'We can’t afford to waste any more time on denial.'

content_blocks.label: pull_quote
content_blocks.text: 'We can’t afford to waste any more time on denial.' – Maria Rodriguez, Environmental Activist
